description: A login portal issues JWTs signed with RS256. The admin panel trusts the role claim in the token and also accepts alg=none.
A binary reads a name into a fixed stack buffer with gets(), no canary, NX enabled. Get a shell with ret2libc.
Messages are encrypted with RSA using a small public exponent and a shared modulus across users.
Reverse engineer this crackme -- disassemble it in Ghidra and find the keygen algorithm.
Analyze this pcap in Wireshark to find hidden files in the network capture using file carving.
Use the photo metadata to geolocate the photographer and correlate the username on social media.
Audit this Solidity smart contract on Ethereum. A withdraw function looks like a reentrancy bug and gas is relevant.
Decompile this Android APK. An exported activity stores the session token in shared preferences.
